description.p: Panero is an independent fork of Krusader. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by KDE or the Krusader maintainers.
It keeps Krusader's file management engine and adds a modernised appearance and a workflow familiar to Total Commander users:

ul.li: Two independent panels with tabs, breadcrumbs, drive selector and a folder tree
Persistent marks separate from the keyboard cursor; right-click marks, holding the right button opens the context menu
Compact, adjustable rows with alternating backgrounds and an Extension column
Archive handling, remote protocols, search, synchronizer and internal viewer/editor from Krusader

description.p: First preview release, based on Krusader 2.8.1.
